steps.action: Close or reopen: Closed group, close dialog with Closing note, open child Matters, Cancel then Close matter
steps.expected: The close dialog requires a note up to 2,000 characters, lists open children and a Restricted Matter; Cancel keeps the Status; Close matter records the Closed date and History keeps the note; children, the Contract and Tasks keep their state; the Matter leaves the default list and active deadlines.
steps.actual: Closed group > Closed opened "Close DOC-030 compat matters admin lifecycle 1790330927835?"; Close matter was disabled with an empty note; typing 2,100 characters kept 2000. Dialog text: "Close DOC-030 compat matters admin lifecycle 1790330927835? Closing note* Open child Matters These child Matters will stay open. Closing this parent changes none of them. M-21 DOC-030 compat matters admin open child 1790330927835 Restricted Matter Cancel Close matter". Cancel kept Status "With external counsel". Close matter with a note saved (200): Category closed, Closed 2026-09-25T10:08:51.661Z, Opened unchanged; Overview Closed reads "Sep 25, 2026"; History first entry "Daniel Okafor changed the status With external counsel → Closed Closing note DOC-030 compat fictional closing note for the walkthrough. this minute". Child M-21 still Open; Contract C-44 still Draft; Task not done; Key date kept (1); nextDeadline null; default list includes it: false.

steps.action: Close or reopen: a closed Matter stays editable, and Filter > Show closed finds it

steps.actual: Description saved on the closed Matter (200); a Task write answered 201. Matters default table listed it: false; after Filter > Show closed: true.

steps.action: Archive or restore: Matter actions > Archive, Cancel, then Archive; archived controls and refusals
steps.expected: Cancel changes nothing; Archive keeps the M- reference and History, removes it from default lists, freezes ordinary changes (Status strip without Move to), and leaves children and the linked Contract unarchived.
steps.actual: Fixture: the Matter was closed again through the API (200). Matter actions > Archive opened "Archive DOC-030 compat matters admin lifecycle 1790330927835? The matter leaves the default list. Its history and M-number are kept. Cancel Archive"; Cancel left archivedAt null. Archive confirmed: header shows M-20 and "Archived"; Status strip reads "Open done In progress done Waiting done Closed" with 0 Move to buttons; Description textbox count 0; direct Description and Status writes answered 409 ("This matter is archived. Restore it before editing.") and 409; the list with closed included omits it: true. History has 12 entries, the newest "archived this matter". Child M-21 archivedAt null; Contract C-44 archivedAt null.

steps.action: Archive or restore: find it with Show archived and Show closed, Restore Cancel, then Restore
steps.expected: Show archived alone does not list a closed archived Matter; adding Show closed does; Restore Cancel keeps it archived; Restore makes it editable and keeps it closed.
steps.actual: Filter > Show archived listed it: false; with Show closed added: true. Matter actions > Restore opened "Restore DOC-030 compat matters admin lifecycle 1790330927835? The matter returns to the default list and becomes editable again. Cancel Restore"; Cancel kept archivedAt 2026-09-25T10:08:56.674Z. Restore confirmed: archivedAt null, Status "Closed" (Category closed), 4 Status groups with Move to menus, Description saved (200).
